{{Quote|The Republic seeks a single, unified government to maintain peace throughout the galaxy, and the Jedi have been reduced to nothing more than a tool to make it happen.|[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], to [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]|<ref name="RoT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>}}
The '''Unification Campaigns''' were a series of conflicts that took place early into the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]] in between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]], led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Lune Banjeer]] and his successors, fought ably in this conflict, achieving notable victories at [[Vondarc/Legends|Vondarc]], [[D'rinba system/Legends|D'rinba]], the [[Klina Marches]], [[Korvaii]] and the [[Dandrian Ring/Legends|Dandrian Ring]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|There will be many people across the galaxy who are opposed to this new legislation. Some see Valorum's efforts to reunite the Republic as an attempt to reestablish Senate control over worlds that have declared their independence&hellip; or worlds that were just about to.|[[Valenthyne Farfalla]], to [[Johun Othone]]|<ref name="RoT" />}}
In the aftermath of the [[New Sith Wars]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] proposed the [[Unification Policies]],<ref name="RoT" /> a set of legal guidelines and recommendations meant to help the reunification of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|280|Unification Policies}}</ref>

After the Unification Policies were enacted, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was allowed to enforce the regulations of membership in the Republic.<ref name="CSWE" />

This new legislation had the effect of drawing many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] back into the web of Republic influence,<ref name="RoT" /> an act that many groups saw as a form of bullying, as they wanted to keep their [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] out of the Republic. As a result, nearly one hundred small separatist movements scattered across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] rose up against the Republic.<ref name="CSWE" />

==The Campaigns==
{{Quote|Each time radicals strike against the Republic, the Jedi Council is called upon to take action. Resources are wasted on quelling rebellions and uprisings, keeping their focus away from us.|[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], to [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]|<ref name="RoT" />}}
Following the enactment of the Unification Policies, sometime between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]], the Galactic Republic conducted a series of conflicts, known as the Unification Campaigns, in an effort to bring the galaxy back under its control.<ref name="EGtW" />

The Galactic Republic's [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] fought ably in the Unification Campaigns of the [[900 BBY/Legends|900s BBY]]. They were first led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Lune Banjeer]], a distinguished veteran of the [[Ruusan campaign]], and later by his successors.<ref name="EGtW" />

The [[Judicial/Legends|Judicials]] achieved notable victories during several battles, including a [[Battle at Vondarc|battle]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vondarc/Legends|Vondarc]], a [[Battle at D'rinba|battle]] in the [[D'rinba system/Legends|D'rinba system]], and a [[Battle at the Klina Marches|battle]] at the [[Klina Marches]].<ref name="EGtW" />

The Judicial Forces served gallantly during a [[Confrontation on Korvaii|confrontation]] on the surface of [[Korvaii]] that ended the [[Melusi Uprising]]. They also fought with distinction at the [[Battle of the Dandrian Ring]], bringing a violent end to the [[Belderone Contention]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|But why must the separatists always fail? We could help them succeed without risking exposure!''"<br />"''If they succeed, they will gain support. Their power and influence will grow. They will become harder to manipulate and control. It is possible they might even become strong enough to bring down the Republic itself.''"<br />"''Isn't that a good thing?''"<br />"''The Republic keeps the Jedi in check. It maintains control and imposes order across thousands of worlds. But if the Republic falls, a score of new interstellar governments and galactic organizations will rise. It is far easier to manipulate and control a single enemy than twenty.|[[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] and [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]|<ref name="RoT" />}}
Some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the Unifications Campaigns, the Judicial Forces went on to play key roles in the [[Mandalorian Excision]] of [[738 BBY]], the [[Battles of the Black Delve]] in the [[690s BBY]], and the [[Utor Shock]] of [[602 BBY]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Unification Campaigns were first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" />
